systems.owner: Principal Secretary of the ministry responsible for registration of persons
systems.tiers: national; a national population register, a unique national identification number, and support for printing identification documents including birth and death certificates (section 9A)
national; citizens aged eighteen and over, with provincial and district registrars

note: The identity-card statute, for adults of eighteen and over. It mentions birth and death certificates only as documents whose printing NIIMS supports, and says nothing on how births and deaths are registered.
